items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I took Jack Purvis ... and we joined Flem's band and we used to play up in the roof garden there in the summertime

ctx.x: But the second time we went to Shreveport, to the hotel there, I took Jack Purvis and a trumpet player by the name of Harley Booth, and a guitar player by the name

of Scoop Thompson, and we joined Flem's band and we used to play up in the roof garden there in the summertime, and Jack Purvis is a -- I don't know if you've ever heard of him -- he was a fantastic musician, a fantastic trumpet player. He could do everything that Louis Armstrong could do in those days. He had a tremendous range for those days. He had himself a G or an A anytime he wanted it. And well, the Louisiana Symphony came to town, and Jack somehow got himself into a deal there where he was going to play…
